card.name: The x meaning 'times' after a dose
card.fires_on: The letter x or the sign × used as 'times' right after a dose or schedule, before a number of days or doses, as in '500 mg x 1 day'.

modes.label: Dose times duration
modes.description: An x follows a dose and frequency and precedes a number of days.

modes.label: Dose times count
modes.description: An × follows a tablet dose and precedes a number of doses.
